purpose: Small fixed Indian-equity diagnostic, not trading strategy validation
notes: Baseline and after use identical cached adjusted OHLCV and the same fold/ticker/origin/label timestamps; identity checked.
Both protocols refit sequence models for the evaluated horizon before each fold; this evaluates model recipes, not shipped artifacts retrospectively.
The shipped sequence artifacts target 30 sessions. Live 7-session ensemble excludes LSTM and matches ENSEMBLE_RF_RULES when its other members are available.
ENSEMBLE_PRODUCTION denotes the configured four-member blend with horizon-matched research refits; at 7 sessions it is not the shipped 30-session bundle.
The baseline harness did not record fallback flags. After harness records availability; all five members covered all 48 origins per horizon.
Inverse-MAE omits the first fold, scores 36 origins, and has a different no-change MAE; it must not be compared by pooled MAE on different samples.
Four surviving large liquid NSE companies, 48 origins per horizon, correlated cross-stock outcomes, and evaluation after late 2022 do not represent all Indian equities or market regimes.
No trading costs, sizing, liquidity constraints, execution or strategy P&L are modelled.
Accuracy changes are mixed; extra historical data does not guarantee lower forecast error. No weights or model hyperparameters were tuned to this diagnostic.
